action: No security action needed. Travellers whose flights were delayed on November 16 should check their booking status and rebooking options with United.
exec: A short systems failure grounded a major airline's departures; no security cause is indicated.
plain: A technology failure on the evening of November 16 stopped United Airlines departures for about 90 minutes. United said it was a technology issue with no indication of a cyberattack.
summary: A technology failure on the evening of November 16 halted United departures for roughly 90 minutes; tools pilots use for aircraft weight and balance were reportedly among the systems hit. United called it a technology-related issue with no indication of a cybersecurity cause. Cyber cause: not indicated.
title: United Airlines systems fail for about 90 minutes

validation.note: Two outlets carry the company's statement.
